name: Citroën Berlingo III M
note: Passenger (Ludospace) size M, 5 seats, 1.5 BlueHDi 130. Rear side doors: sliding (both sides). l'argus and auto-data agree on overhangs (892/726), tracks and tyre; fo+wb+ro = 4403 = L. Width with mirrors folded 1921 (l'argus shows 1.92 m as 'largeur', i.e. the folded-mirror figure). Height 1844 as listed by auto-data (l'argus 1.84 m); sources do not state whether it includes roof bars. Official Stellantis media PDF could not be fetched (HTTP 403).

name: Volkswagen Caddy 5 Life (short wheelbase)
note: Passenger Caddy (Kombi/Life), short wheelbase, 5 seats. Rear side doors: sliding. Overhangs 890/855 from l'argus (Life 2.0 TDI 122 DSG7) and auto-data, sum = L exactly. L 4500, W 1855 (excl. mirrors), wb 2755 confirmed by the official VW press data sheet (Oct 2020). Height is uncertain: 1833 is the figure carwow.de lists for the Life trim (roof rails standard; auto-data 1832), the official VW press data sheet gives 1818 without naming the variant, and trade press quotes 1797 for the base car; none of the sources states explicitly what is included. Tracks 1568/1603 are single-source (carwow.de, 16-inch wheels); l'argus does not list tracks. carwow.de lists L 4510 for current Life (unexplained 10 mm difference); mirrors folded 1931.

name: Ford S-Max II (facelift 2019)
note: FRONT AND REAR OVERHANG NOT FOUND in any source (l'argus sheet, auto-data, autotijd and the official Ford technical specification all omit them) - left null, not derived. Rear side doors: hinged. W 1916, Wm 2137 (1953 folded), wb 2850 and tracks 1606/1606 are from the official Ford of Europe technical specification (S-MAX Hybrid, 2021). L 4796 and H 1655 are the 2.0 EcoBlue figures from auto-data and autotijd (body height); the official Hybrid sheet gives L 4804 and height 1684-1710 'with shark fin antenna'. Pre-facelift (2015-2018) wheelbase is listed as 2849. Only L - wb = 1946 (sum of both overhangs) is known.

name: Renault Grand Scénic IV
note: 1.3 TCe 140 Intens, 5 seats (7-seat body has the same exterior). Rear side doors: hinged. Overhangs 931/899 agree in l'argus, auto-data and autotijd; sum = L exactly (autotijd rounds L to 4635). Tracks disagree between sources: l'argus 1594/1583 (used), autotijd 1594/1587, auto-data 1602/1596 - treat rear track as uncertain within about 13 mm. Height 1655 per l'argus/autotijd; auto-data gives 1655-1660 (the larger value presumably with roof bars; not stated). Official Renault brochure with the dimension drawing was not found.

name: BMW 2 Series Active Tourer (U06)
note: 218i / 218d. Rear side doors: hinged. Front overhang 861 is stated by auto-data; l'argus lists only the rear overhang (855), and L - wb - 855 = 861 confirms it. Tracks 1586/1587 from auto-data (218d) and autotijd (218i); l'argus gives 1579/1581 for M Sport on 225/50 R18, auto-data 1586/1588 for 220d. Width with mirrors 2102 is single-source (auto-data 220d page). Height 1576 per auto-data/autotijd; BMW UK web page was reported with 1570 in a search snippet but timed out on fetch, so not verified. Official BMW technical data not fetched.

name: Ford Tourneo Connect III (short, L1)
note: FRONT AND REAR OVERHANG NOT FOUND (no source lists them) - left null; L - wb = 1760 is the sum of both. TRACKS left null because the only source (auto-data) gives ranges, not one value: front 1565-1572, rear 1603-1606 depending on wheels. Rear side doors: sliding. 1.5 EcoBoost 114, 5 seats. L 4515 per auto-data and l'argus (4.52 m; Active 4.52 m too); ADAC lists 4500 (the VW Caddy figure, same body shell) and auto-data's PHEV page also shows 4500 - length differs by trim/bumper, so 4515 may not apply to every version. W 1855, Wm 2100, H 1833, wb 2755 agree in auto-data and ADAC. The vehicle is built on the VW Caddy 5 body (Caddy overhangs 890/855 with L 4500), but those values were NOT copied here.

name: Mercedes-Benz B-Class (W247)
note: B 180 / B 180 d, pre-facelift body (2018-2022). Rear side doors: hinged. Overhangs 914/776 agree in l'argus and auto-data, sum = L exactly. Rear track disagrees: auto-data 1547 (used), l'argus 1558 for the B 180 Business Line; front track 1567 in both. Width with mirrors 2020 is single-source (auto-data). Facelift 2022 width is listed as 1797. No roof rails on this model. Official Mercedes data sheet not fetched.

name: Volkswagen Amarok II Double Cab
note: Double cab. L 5350, W 1910, H 1884, wb 3270 and bed length 1624 are from the official VW South Africa specification brochure (2023); that brochure also gives 1227 between wheelhouses and 529 side-wall height. Overhangs 865/1215 and tracks 1620/1650 agree in auto-data and CarExpert (AU); sum = L exactly. Second variant exists: German-market Life/Style are listed with L 5390 and rear overhang 1251 (carwow.de; implies front 869) - l'argus shows 1.251/0.869 with the front/rear labels swapped. carwow.de gives rear track 1620. Bed width 1584 is single-source (l'argus 'largeur utile', max inside width; l'argus bed length 1640 disagrees with the official 1624; CarExpert lists 1544). Base trims are 1751 high on 17-inch wheels (255/70 R17).

name: Mitsubishi L200 V Double Cab (KJ/KK/KL)
note: All numbers are the PRE-FACELIFT fifth generation (2015-2019), double cab, 2.4 DI-D 181 4WD with rear step bumper. Overhangs 865/1420 in auto-data and cararac (possibly the same underlying database; Parkers showed the same values in a search snippet but could not be fetched), sum = L exactly. Base trims without rear bumper: L 5205, rear overhang 1340, W 1785. The 2019 facelift is L 5305 per l'argus (5.31 m; auto-data 5300) with the same wheelbase, tracks and width; its front overhang was only seen as 880 in a Parkers search snippet (unverified), so facelift overhangs are not given. Bed 1520 x 1470 from l'argus 'longueur/largeur utile' (facelift sheet; same bed, Parkers snippet gives identical values for 2015-2019). Width with mirrors not found. l'argus does not list overhangs or tracks for this model.

name: Nissan Navara (D23) Double Cab
note: European NP300 Navara double cab, 2.3 dCi. Overhangs 870/1310 and tracks 1570/1570 agree in l'argus (2019 Acenta and N-Connecta) and auto-data (2015-2019); sum = L exactly. auto-data's 'facelift 2019' page gives 880/1300 instead (same L and wb). Height varies by trim: 1805 used (auto-data lower value; l'argus 1.81 m for Acenta on 255/65 R17), l'argus 1.82 m for N-Connecta on 255/60 R18, auto-data up to 1840 (top trims, presumably with roof rails - not stated). Width with mirrors 2085 is single-source (auto-data). Bed 1578 x 1560 from l'argus 'longueur/largeur utile' (Parkers showed the same in a search snippet); whether measured at floor is not stated.

name: Isuzu D-Max III Double Cab
note: Double (Crew) cab, pre-facelift 2020-2023. Overhangs 890/1250 agree in l'argus (1.9 Ddi 164 Crew), auto-data and CarExpert; sum = L exactly. Tracks 1570/1570 in auto-data and CarExpert. BED LENGTH IS UNCERTAIN: 1570 (used) is the cargo length given by CarExpert AU and, per a search snippet, the Isuzu NZ spec ('floor length'); European sources (l'argus 'longueur utile', Parkers snippet) give 1495, apparently a different measuring convention (top of bed). Bed width 1530 agrees everywhere; 1122 between wheelhouses, 490 depth (CarExpert). Width with mirrors not found. The 2023 facelift is listed with L 5280 and front overhang 905 (auto-data search snippet) - not used.

name: SsangYong/KGM Musso (Q200, standard bed)
note: Short (standard) bed double cab, not the Musso Grand / long bed (L 5405, wb 3210). Overhangs 890/1105 and tracks 1640/1640 agree in l'argus and auto-data; sum = L exactly. carsales (AU) gives front overhang 891. Bed 1300 x 1570 agrees in l'argus ('longueur/largeur utile') and carsales (load length/width); measuring height not stated. Height 1840 without roof rails (auto-data lists 1840-1870). Width 1950 as listed (body width; mirrors not stated), width with mirrors not found. Base tyre 235/70 R17 also common.

name: Jeep Gladiator (JT)
note: All numbers are from the official FCA '2020 Jeep Gladiator Specifications' sheet (US specification, Sport/Overland, hardtop; mm values printed in the document): fo 755 + wb 3487 + ro 1296 = 5538 vs L 5539. EUROPEAN/AU-MARKET FIGURES DIFFER: l'argus, auto-data and CarExpert list the export Overland 3.0 V6 diesel at L 5591, W 1894, wb 3488, H 1843-1905 - 52 mm longer and 19 mm wider (bumper / flares); no source splits that 5591 into overhangs, so the US-spec set is used to keep the item internally consistent. Rubicon: tracks 1636/1636, height 1882 hardtop. Soft top height 1907. Bed: 1531 box length with tailgate closed, 1442 cargo width (1138 between wheelhouses per CarExpert). l'argus shows the same 1531 x 1442. Width with mirrors not found.

name: Ford F-150 SuperCrew 5.5 ft box (14th gen)
note: Official Ford '2021 F-150 Technical Specifications' PDF (copy hosted on a forum), SuperCrew 5.5-ft Styleside. The document is in inches; mm values are unit conversions (x25.4, rounded) and match auto-data's mm figures: wb 145.4 in, L 231.7 in, width excl. mirrors 79.9 in, incl. standard mirrors 95.7 in (83.6 in / 2123 folded; 105.9 in / 2690 with trailer-tow mirrors), tracks 67.9/68.3 in, overhangs 37.6/48.6 in. fo+wb+ro = 5882 vs L 5885 (3 mm, inch rounding). Height 1961 = cab height 77.2 in for 4x4; 4x2 is 75.6 in (1920). Bed: inside length at floor 67.1 in = 1704; width between wheelhouses 51.1 in = 1298; inside height 21.4 in = 544. bedW 1656 IS FROM A DIFFERENT TRIM SHEET: the standard F-150 sheet does not give maximum inside width; 65.2 in 'maximum width inside box' comes from the official 2021 F-150 Raptor sheet (same generation, same SuperCrew 5.5-ft box with the same 67.1 in floor length, but that sheet lists 50.6 in at the wheelhouse) - use 1298 if the between-wheelhouse figure is wanted.
